byUnit.unit: Bravissimo La Joia del Barri Vell

list.txt: - Nous avons passé un très bon séjour. Le logement est propre, bien équipé et agréable. La communication avec l’hôte a été fluide du début à la fin. Adresse à recommander.
- Nous avons passé un très bon séjour. Le logement est propre, bien équipé et agréable. La communication avec l’hôte a été fluide du début à la fin. Adresse à recommander.
- L'apartament es molt agradable i confortable, està ben equipat i es troba en una molt bona ubicació per visitar el centre històric de la ciutat

- Le logement est parfaitement situé. Très propre et fonctionnel pour 6 personnes sans problème ! C’est une rue piétonne au cœur de la vieille ville donc bruyant du côté salon mais pas du côté chambre.

list.unit: Bravissimo La Joia del Barri Vell
list.txt: - El apartamento es de lujo, con detalles espectaculares. Sólo hay un aspecto que debería mejorarse: debido a la forma de recogida de residuos municipal, el procedimiento es muy complicado y sacar la basura el último día es prácticamente imposible. El propietario debería hacerse cargo de ese último día de recogida de residuos y asumir la gestión.
- Casa perfetta , ampia, pulita ,funzionale, con tutto quello che può servire host super disponibile e con risposte immediate ad ogni richiesta Una delle migliori mie esperienze su Airbnb
- Great location
- Great location, quick communication and professional team
- Appartement idéalement placé, confortable. Les hôtes proposent des solutions, notamment pour le parking. Je recommande !
- We, family of four, staid for three nights. The apartment was ideally located to experience and explore Girona.
- War super
- Bueno
- 히로나는 작은 마을이어서 역과 볼거리가 매우 가깝다. 역 근처 숙소로 가성비가 매우 좋았고 모든 시설이 비교적 최신이고 깨끗했다. 적극 추천!!
- Nice and easy communication. Every thing was as expected and as it should be

- My family of six had an amazing experience during our three day, two night stay in Girona. The house itself was very spacious, impeccably designed with a rustic/modern mix that was cozy and functional and everything worked and was well maintained. Bravisimo took care of all the details, even setting up a crib for the baby and letting us leave our luggage before checkin at their office, and was always helpful and responsive. Be sure to check out the biker themed restaurant next door and to spend enough time in Girona. Highly recommended.
- Sehr preiswert und sauber. Gute Lage hat alles was man braucht.

- Beautiful, well-maintained apartment in the heart of Girona. The location couldn’t be better. The apartment was spotless, modern, and very comfortable. Highly recommend. The host was very responsive.
- Muy buen apartamento y coincide como en las imágenes. Muy central, limpio y organizado y cómodo y es tal cual como en las fotos. Una muy buena estadía larga en el lugar para mis padres.
- bel appartement, confortable pour 4 personnes (2 adultes et 2 enfants). a proximité de la ville historique à pieds. parking voiture gratuit de la muraille à 700m

list.unit: Bravissimo La Joia del Barri Vell
list.txt: - Great place to stay in Girona, especially for cycling. Quiet, comfortable, and well located with easy access to cafes, bike shops, and the train station. Perfect to relax after long rides. Simple, calm vibe with real Girona cycling energy. Would happily stay again.
- todo bien
- 첫날 찬 물이 나와서 샤워를 못했지만 아침에 와서 해결해주셨어요 깔끔하거 좋았습니다!
- ottimo in tutto !!! comodissimo ,pulito e posizionato bene !!
- Wonderfully spacious beautifully designed apartment in the heart of the old town. Shops and restaurants at your doorstep, walking distance to everything.

- the only thing I would point out is that you can't drive to the door to drop off your stuff, but you can get pretty close. if you're lugging lots of baggage be aware that you'll be walking up some really cool old stairs to get to the apartment. this is a special place in a magical setting. highly recommend.
- Such a lovely apartment, beautiful view and surroundings. The check is was easy and the staff was very friendly. Really enjoyed our stay there.
- Juste fantastique
- Logement qui correspond 100% à la description, en plus d’être bien placé et spacieux. Je recommande totalement :)
- Endroit très confortable et bien aménagé. Bien situé. L'hôte apparait très organisé et communique de façon claire et bienveillante.
- Anfitrião que responde rápido. Apartamento idêntico ao das fotos. Boa localização. Tudo bem arrumado. Recomendo.
- We really enjoyed our stay. The location was perfect and home was beautiful and very quiet.
- Muy contentos con el alojamiento
- La estancia genial, la verdad que el sitio ha cumplido todas las expectativas. 10/10.

- Die Wohnung entsprach ganz und gar der Beschreibung. Ein kleines Problem wurde durch den profesionellen Vermieter schnell behoben. Tolle Lage in der Altstadt mit Bars und Restaurants, wenn du dich nicht an den Nachtschwärmern störst. Empfehlenswert.

- Logement idéalement situé pour visiter Girona et son cœur historique. Parking gratuit à 5 min à pied avec possibilité de déposer les bagages devant la porte. Le logement est sobre, propre et plein de charme. Literie très confortable. Il dispose de tous les équipements de première nécessité. Très bonne communication avec nos hôtes. Nous recommandons +++
- Nadat we eindelijk binnen waren hebben we een prima verblijf gehad. Wel mistten we koffie en thee om bij aankomst te kunnen gebruiken
- Great place to stay in girona! Nice location, very nice apartment and flexible check in with electronic door. Definitely recommend!
- Heel fijn verblijf , prachtige Stad , mooi en uitstekend uitgangs punt voor sporten. Bravissimo was via de app ten alle tijden bereikbaar. Super host
- estancia maravillosa, tuvimos una confusión respecto a como se subía la cama y nos atendieron enseguida, piso céntrico y bonito.

- We had a great stay here! The space was well set up and a good size for our family. The location is perfect, close to many supermarkets, restaurants and cafes. The team at Bravissimo was helpful and responsive. We would stay again!

- We loved our stay! I am so glad to have chosen this Airbnb. Host was extremely flexible and understanding with our delayed trains and delayed check in, very communicative and helpful when trying to get into the unit while we had bad data reception on our phones, and the place is beautiful. Stocked with the basics- has comfy bed and easy to get out and walk.
- Sehr gute Lage. Hatte alles gleich um die Wohnung herum. Einkaufen, Restaurant, Mülldeponie, Laufstrecken.
- Cute place in the middle of old town. The Bravissimo team also helped us with the parking and fees, which was very much appreciated!
- Très bon séjour avec Bravissimo, logement très propre et conforme à la description !
- Genial
- ottima esperienza, posizione molto centrale, con autobus sotto casa e fornito di tutti i servizi. Casa in ordine, pulita e fornita anche di sufficienti utensili in cucina.
- We had a pleasant stay. Great location!
- The location, ease of access, restaurants, and responsiveness of the team made our stay with Bravissimo great.
- El apartamento coincide con la descripción y las fotos, muy buena ubicación, espacioso, limpio, buena comunicación, fácil acceso, lo recomiendo!
- Great apartment and great location

- Nice flat in central Girona with small balcony - lovely view of the old town. Quiet when you consider the central location (winter so we had doors and windows closed). Clean and with all the equipment that we needed (dish washer; washing machine; two toilets). The single beds were a little short for my adult sons, but we managed. The system for handling waste in the inner city is a little complicated, but managable and we got fast and precise instructions from Bravissimo, when there was doubt. Door opening is handled via a homepage - this worked OK, but we recommed to open the webpage a little before you get to the door (network not always very fast close to the door to the building). Once you are in the apartment, there was also a key to the main entrance and a code for the door to the flat.
- We really enjoyed our stay. Thank you for the hospitality.

- Beautiful apartment and location. Extremely clean and well furniture. The check in was very smooth and they even went above and beyond to resolve my parking ticket for the week. There is a coffee pod shop directly opposite the front entrance for the coffee machine named Boutique Nespresso Girona - Santa Clara. And an amazing cafe down the road is named casamoner Santa Clara. Honestly, if i stayed there much longer i would have gained KG's from that place. It had the most beautiful foods for breakfast.

list.unit: Bravissimo La Joia del Barri Vell
list.txt: - Appartamento moderno e ben progettato nel quartiere più bello di Girona. Ottima comunicazione con tutto lo staff di Bravissimo che ha risposto sempre velocemente e con precisione. Ci tornerò!
- Muy céntrico, tranquilo, ascensor, limpio, ordenado, cómodo y espacioso. Un 10

- In the heart of Barri Vell, this flat is ideally located. A perfect spot to live catalunian experience and enjoy Girona. Top end furnitures, good night of sleep in a comfy bed and pillows. Easy to park a car in the public parking lot just next door.

- Our first apartment was under maintenance , but worked out well here - great location, keyless entry and comfy beds. Would be nice touch if had a selection of coffee caps for coffee machine. Otherwise no complaints , would definitely stay again . Thank you
- Appartement top, bien placé, très bonne literie et propre ! l'hôte est très réactif en cas de besoin. On entend un peu les voisins

- We had a great stay in Girona. Lovely apartment right at the heart of the city, spaceous, clean and as on the pictures. Communication and everything around our trip was made easy, thanks a lot! I would book it again.
- Alles perfect in orde
- Hat alles super geklappt. Lediglich Räder in den 4. Stock zu bekommen ist herausfordernd aber zur Not möglich. Sonst hat alles gepasst
- Simple check-in, superb location, right in the heart of Old Girona, the appartment was as described and well-equipped. Highly recommend!
- Top
- Super appartement près de bons restos, idéal pour planifier quelques jours (à vélo ou pas) à Gérone

- Great studio apartment with everything you need. The host company is very friendly and informative, they also provided several amenities like small washing soap etc. which makes perfect sense when you only stay for a couple of days. Also easy communication with them, and they handle requests or questions quick and professionally. The apartment is in a great location in the old town. The only thing is you hear a lot in the building, not really sound-proof walls

- Todo perfecto con este apartamento y la gente de Bravisimo. Zona muy central en la ciudad, al lado de restaurantes y tiendas de bici. Ideal para 1 semana y montar en bici, o simplemente visitar la ciudad de Girona
- A tiny bit noisy but amazing location and a great apartment.
- Our experience was wonderful! There is a way to avoid all the steps for the easiest approach to the building. You really can’t beat the location. Highly recommended!
- Great apartment - compact but comfortable with great views and the essentials all provided. Brilliant location for enjoying Girona. Thanks
- Parfait !
- Beautiful beautiful space and surroundings!!!

- I gave 5*, but it's becoming frustrating that you have to be an expert in reading photos. I understand that you take photos that advantage your place, but there's a thin line when it almost becomes a con. The flat is very small, it has less than 40m2. The managers of the place can/should be more careful, we didn't have soap for the first day. Given that it's so small, I find it difficult to not notice that something is missing. Apart from these details, it was nice and clean, the area is wonderful. It has balconies twards the river and the narrow streets from the city center, a market one minute away and many restaurants. I feel that with little effort and a bit more clarity, the impression would be better overall.
- Very clean and easy to access
- Un séjour parfait avec une équipe Bravissimo toujours réactive pour trouver des solutions et/ou répondre aux différentes questions. Un grand merci
- Great location perfect spot in Old town
- 2ème séjour dans cet appartement et toujours aussi satisfait ! Agréable, spacieux, lumineux et bien situé.
- Sehr nette, gut gelegene Unterkunft in der Altstadt von Girona.
- Top Lage in Altstadt alles zu Fuß erreichbar und gut Ausgestattet. Check in sehr unkompliziert.
- Bastante bien, un poco lioso el metodo de entrada al principio, pero al final pudimos averiguarlo
- Ce logement était fidèle à la description, propre, bien équipé et bien placé. Bravissimo a été réactif dans ses messages. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour, nous recommandons.
- Top!
- Buena ubicación y espacio cómodo con todas las comodidades.
- Merci pour ce séjours
- Rigtig fint ophold i boligen som lå meget tæt på alle relevante seværdigheder, restauranter mv.
- Très bon séjour ! Proche toutes commodités à pieds +++
- Wir hatten eine super Zeit in der Wohnung. Die Lage ist top und die Wohnung hat eine gute Ausstattung.
- Ich hatte einen tollen Aufenthalt in der Wohnung mitten in der Altstadt von Girona. Ich komme gerne wieder.

- I thought this was in terms of location superb. Great price-quality ratio. Team Bravisimo was super pleasant. Probably the appartment looks a tiny bit more romantic than it is (interior) in reality, but that's a detail. The location is amazing, I thought it was quite special to get out of the appartment and have time to check out that insane cathedral. Foodwise Girona is a mecca and tons of nice places all around. Overall very very recommended and I would stay here yesterday again.

Obyt był absolutnie wyjątkowy — apartament oferował wszystko jak w domu, a komfort, czystość i wyposażenie znacznie prze - Pobyt w tym apartamencie zdecydowanie przeszedł moje oczekiwania — gdybym mógł, dałbym 20/10. Mieszkanie jest w pełni wyposażone we wszystko, czego można potrzebować: ogrzewanie, klimatyzację, pralkę, suszarkę, a także każdy możliwy rodzaj naczyń i sprzętów do gotowania. Naprawdę czułem się jak w domu — było dosłownie wszystko. Ogromnym plusem jest też bardzo proste, bezobsługowe wejście. Dodatkowo istnieje możliwość zostawienia walizek w biurze zarówno przed zameldowaniem, jak i po wymeldowaniu — wystarczy zapytać. Łóżko było bardzo wygodne, a w zimie w pokojach panowało przyjemne ciepło dzięki grzejnikom i centralnemu ogrzewaniu. Pokoje są przestronne, bardzo czyste i dobrze zaciemnione, co rzadko się zdarza — można się naprawdę dobrze wyspać. Dodatkowym atutem był głośnik oraz piękny widok z balkonu. Łazienka również na najwyższym poziomie — świetnej jakości ręczniki i bardzo estetyczne wykończenie. Spędziliśmy tu tydzień podczas naszego Erasmusa i naprawdę poczułem się jak u siebie. Podróżowałem i spałem w wielu miejscach na świecie, ale nigdzie nie czułem się tak dobrze jak tutaj. Rzadko piszę opinie, ale to miejsce zdecydowanie na nią zasługuje. Z całego serca polecam — to był wyjątkowy pobyt. Jedynym drobnym minusem może być to, że jeśli ktoś chce chodzić spać bardzo wcześnie (np. około 22:00), to do około 23:00–24:00 może być trochę głośniej ze względu na pobliski bar. Nie jest to jednak duży problem — później robi się już całkowicie cicho, nawet w weekendy, ponieważ bar zamyka się stosunkowo wcześnie.

Beautiful apartment design as well, very bright. A perfect home away from home. Easy check-in. I also appreciated their information and assistance with parking. They made it very easy to pay for a parking spot in the nearby garage. Additionally, providing information about the area. We felt very welcomed to Girona. Hosts were also very responsive, we had an issue with the water and they came a remedied it immediately. Nothing! Great place to explore Girona and surrounding areas.

Stylish Girona Apartment - A beautiful, stylish apartment in the heart of Girona’s old quarter, close to everything. We loved staying here as a family and enjoyed the charm and character of the property. A note for guests with heavy luggage: there is no lift and the apartment is up two flights of narrow stairs, car access is understandably limited in the old town. However, these small challenges are well worth it for such a fabulous location and wonderful apartment.
- La comodidad de las camas y toallas.cetca del casco antiguo.Casa muy cómoda. Falta de armario en dos dormitorios.

- La climatisation était tres appréciable!! Il faisait très chaud! L'agencement de l'appartement est très agréable. A 4 on est vraiment à l'aise. Localisation parfaite. Il manque un grille pain. C'est tout.
- Lots of space, fully equipped kitchen, very clean. Communication with staff was great
Apartamento que tinha muita coisa pra fazer ao redor - Muito aconchegante e muito bem localizado O que atrapalhava era o sino, que acho que era da prefeitura bem próximo ao apartamento

Fantastic stay in Girona Old Town - Beautiful property and very comfortable. Lovely air con! Location was perfect - close to everything in the old town but also down a slightly quieter street. We had a brilliant stay and would definitely return. Nothing!
- Lovely apartment, great location in the old town, but still peaceful and quiet. Lack of proper air con in Spain hot summer heat.

Very cool apartment in a very cool city. Will definitely go back. - Stylish apartment in a great location. Only 1 bathroom was challenging with 2 adult children 😂 but we made it work and if nothing else it made them appreciate what they have at home! It was very hot and there is no aircon but the ceiling fans worked very well. The best room for coolness is the one near the kitchen.

Spotless, modern apartment situated on the river in the Old Town. Great location for sightseeing. - Modern and very clean apartment with everything you need. Easy 15min walk from Girona train+bus station. Great location along the river in the Old Town, perfect for Game of Thrones sightseeing. Plenty of great restaurants on your doorstep. We found the pillows a bit hard but it didn't affect our stay.
The perfect place to stay! - Beautifully decorated, with everything you need for a short city break! Perfect for cyclists as well!! No complaints to be had!!
Volveremos - Tranquilo y muy limpio
Wonderful stay, perfect location for us and lovely apartment - Location s amazing

Lovely apartment, great location. - Very clean lovely apartment in the perfect location for exploring Girona. Loved it. A little nervous about signing a rental agreement and giving a deposit but it was quickly returned and all fine in the end.
- Ubicación y que el apartamento está como recién reformado. No había sal, ni aceite, ni escobilla del wáter, ni escurre platos,...detallitos.

Grande, nuevo y espacioso. - Bien ubicado pegado al centro. Todo nuevo. Camas cómodas y nada ruidoso. Faltaría en la cocina unos mínimos de azúcar o sal ya que no hay nada y también alguna percha en los baños. El parking que recomienda es muy caro.
Bello - La posizione Niente

Excellent! - We loved how spacious and cool this appartment was, and how easy it was to shop at market and cool at home all in easy range of the city sites. The stairs to apartment are narrow and steep
Repetiría sin duda, súper cómodo - Muy limpio y ordenado y la ubicación Quizá que apenas hay cobertura pero bueno el wifi funciona bien
- Ubicación muy cerca del centro. Cocina bien equipada y cama cómoda. El sistema del check-in muy eficiente y rápido. Buena experiencia. No le pongo ningún pero...
Great stay in a fab location with friends - The apartment was lovely, really modern contemporary design. The air con could have been a bit cooler but it was 34.
Buenas condiciones y muy bien equipado - Es muy cómodo y limpio
El equipo de contacto maravilloso y super atento, y el alojamiento es exactamente como lo anuncian. - There are no comments available for this review

- Excellent very large apartment, modern , clean , well maintained. 2 large double bedrooms. Lovely terrace. Fab location .Exactly as in the photos . Air-conditioning was great . Probably one of the best apartments we have stayed in . Just a couple of small things would have enhanced the stay : wish you had a long mirror in the 2nd bedroom . The socket by the mirror in the hall didn't work . Waste bins in the bathrooms and hooks for towels . Though these are minor and we would definitely recommend and return, we we come back to Girona
- Great quality and condition of apartment. Felt good value N/A

Geweldig appartement op een toplokatie! - Top lokatie! Geweldig appartement! Leuk ingericht. Alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig! Midden in de oude wijk! Je moet wel een aantal trappen op,omdat het appartement op de bovenste verdieping is gelegen! Super geregeld met de app van Bravissimo waardoor inchecken zo makkelijk is! Het enige minpunt is dat er geen rookmelders aanwezig zijn!
- Excelente opción en Girona.
- Superbe Rien à dire
- Help was available straight away, especially after midnight. I would have liked one double bed in one of the bedrooms
- Fantástico
La atención excelente, siempre pendientes de tu estadía - Muy bn
Brilliant - Great location, powerful air con, spacious kitchen and bedrooms. Good space for bike storage The stairs are narrow for bringing a bike up
- Everything, great location and apartment
Amazing weekend in an amazing city - Location was amazing - so close to the old town. Very clean and tidy. Two great bathrooms. Very well appointed flat.

Gdybym miała kiedyś wrócić to na pewno w to samo miejsce - Blisko do przepięknej starówki.Wyposażenie apartamentu - nie brakowało niczego,ponad to czysto ,przestronnie . Udogodnieniem też była winda,wiadomo z walizkami po schodach to ciężko. Okolica spokojna . Blisko przystanek komunikacji miejskiej. Brak
- Wonderful location, fantastic view and clean facilities. Shops 5 min walk with all the necessary items. Helpful and attentive supporting team. Highly recomended.

- Appartement très propre, lumineux et parfaitement conforme à la description. Emplacement idéal pour profiter de Gérone ! Un grand merci et un grand bravo à Bravissimo pour son accueil parfait, sa gentillesse et sa gestion irréprochable du début à la fin. Tout était réuni pour passer un excellent séjour. Je recommande sans hésitation.
C’etais incroyable et confortable - Très bon accueil, patient et agréable

- An amazing location with a lovely courtyard; the apartment had everything needed for daily living. I especially appreciated the books and paintings about Girona. There is free parking right nearby, which was also a great plus.
Emplacement exceptionnel, appartement très confortable ! - Emplacement confort accueil Rien

Great location. - Loved the terrace and compact apartment with everything needed in a convenient location. Easy instructions to get in even though arriving at 4am. Enjoyed the lovely city if Girona. Nothing.
- todo
August 2026 stay - Lovely spacious apartment with everything needed for a short stay, comfortable beds and great air con

Beautiful accommodation, very relaxing and great location to explore! - Great location to explore both Girona and Barcelona. Beautiful penthouse with everything we needed would definitely recommend. A warning about the bells ringing often nearby would have been appreciated but it did not take away from how beautiful the penthouse was or what a wonderful location.
Perfect stay - We truly enjoyed the location and the appartment itself. Everything was perfect, definitely would come back again.
- Emplacement idéal, appartement bien agencé, bien équipé et conforme aux photos. Literie au top. Au regard des fortes chaleurs nous avons apprécié la climatisation. Tout était parfait !

Excellent location - We booked this for a group traveling to Banyoles for the European multisport championships. The best part was the location. Right beside the bus stop and the old town, restaurants etc. Little confusing checking in, it's self check in. But it just took getting used to.
- Świetny pomocny personel, apartament czysty i przyjemny spokojny a w centrum

- Horrible area, homeless people in front of your door. Always creepy watching you in and out. I was very uncomfortable as I travelled alone and they did not bother helping. It’s a HUGE miss that this is not disclaimed upfront. I ended up booking a last minute stay elsewhere because according to them, unless the people didn’t molested me, they were not going to help. Btw, they had an open apartment available and refused to transfer or provide any refund. Extremely disappointed, I won’t ever stay with them again and definitely will share with friends to avoid any of their apartments.
- A very small, very basic and cheaply equipped and furnished apartment.

- Not sure how none of the previous reviews mentioned the issues we experienced. First of all, the windows are single-glazed and the bedroom faces a busy street, so you can hear the traffic almost as if you were outside. I really struggled to sleep on the first night as I kept being woken up early in the morning. Secondly, the shower drain was clogged, meaning you had to pause the shower every minute to let the water drain, otherwise the bathroom would flood. On top of that, the flat was filled with insects. We saw flies, spiders, moths, and even a silverfish. I took photos of everything. We ended up using insect spray on the first night and had to sleep with the smell because we were worried that opening the windows would let even more insects in. Finally, while the property looks immaculate in the pictures, in reality the curtains were dirty and the walls were scratched. Overall, I don't think this property offers good value for money, especially for just two people.

- No es un piso para ir en verano. Mucho calor y ruido de la calle principal. Solo hay aire acondicionado en el salon y no llega a las habitaciones. El resto de amenities muy bien: cocina completa, piso reformado bastante nuevo, baños bien. No hay ascensor. Sistema de acceso muy cómodo, sin necesidad de llave. La verdad que nos sorprendió mucho y fue muy practico -con un link se gestionaba todo desde el movil. Huésped muy atento. Fueron estrictos con la hora de check out pero nos dejaron dejar las maletas en sus oficinas durante medio dia del domingo (gracias!)

- Un appartement un peu dépouillé avec peu de personnalité. Il n’y a presque plus de décoration comme sur les photos. Une lampe d’ambiance dans le salon ? Un vase ? Ensuite, équipement de la cuisine de mauvaise qualité. Ça pourrait être parfait mais il manque un peu d’investissement. L’emplacement est parfait, les lits aussi. Merci!

- In general a good place to stay. Not as noisy as expected considered the location. If you’re coming with bikes and lots of luggage I don’t recommend the place due to a very narrow stairway up to fourth floor. The host was really communicative and helpful though.

- Excellent communication from the hosts. Easy self check in. Fantastic location in the old town and directly above the best coffee shop in Girona. Good amount of space for two people but the lounge and dining area would be a bit tight with 4. Overall very happy with the location and the general accommodation but definitely wouldn't stay here again. The place was not perfectly clean. Lots of dust, sticky marks on the floor. Generally a bit tired and in need of maintenance. Mould in the shower. Bathroom sink blocked. No cooking essentials. Not even salt and pepper. Only 2 dishwasher tabs for a week. Not enough toilet paper for a week and it was really cheap stuff. Towel rails were rusty. Cupboard doors in the bathroom were peeling off. Fridge door didn't close properly. Dirty cutlery and crockery. Bathroom sink blocked. The hob didn't light and we had to use matches for it. And the extractor fan above the hob didn't work. It was a good price but I can see why now. Won't be back.

- We overall liked the stay, but the street in front of the apartment is super noisy. You should bring earplugs. It would be lovely if basics like salt, dish soap, tabs for dishwasher or toilet paper could be stocked. Despite this the kitchen is well equipped, the living room is very nice and the host is super responsive.

- Kleines Apartment in der Altstadt von Girona. Insgesamt war alles in Ordnung und wie beschrieben. Die Wohnung war für uns als Paar mit einem kleinen Baby im Nachhinein ein bisschen zu klein. Insbesondere das Bad und das sehr winzige Waschbecken war eine kleine Herausforderung. Die Wohnung könnte ein kleines Update bekommen was die Ausstattung angeht. Das Sofa könnte gereinigt werden. Die Polster von der Sitzgarnitur auf dem Balkon waren durch den vielen Regen und hohe Luftfeuchtigkeit im Winter verschimmelt und daher für uns unbenutzbar. Diese sollten gereinigt und im Zukunft besser drin gelagert werden. Ansonsten ist der Balkon definitiv das Highlight dieser Wohnung auf dem man die Sonnenuntergänge über Girona genießen kann.

- Staying at this Bravissimo location allows for easy access to walk to and enjoy all the central spots in Girona. The rooms, including bathroom, feel spacious. There was a warm greeting at check-in at the office to get the key. The apartment feels secure, yet more like a college dorm with wear and scuffs, than hotel or family-cared for place. Expect to hear bells chiming in the distance and people conversing/carrying on until late at night from outside. Early mornings are quiet, though, and the view of wall is cool.

- A lovely apartment and a very pleasant stay. However the visit was marred by two serious issues. The apartment is well located in Girona in terms of walking to visit places. The building is a little odd as it seems more commercial than residential. However the apartment itself is very comfortable and quiet. I couldn't fault the apartment itself. And the company were very helpful and responsive when I had any issues. Regarding the two issues, firstly the entry instructions could be far better. It took me a long time (and help from the company) to finally locate the correct door. And food delivery drivers also struggled so it isn't just a "tourist issue". The bigger issue was the parking advice. I parked up in the nearest car park as recommended. And because there was reference to a charge of 15 EUR per day decided to keep my car there rather than move it to a free car park. However I ended up being charged 232 EUR. Why wasn't this highlighted in the parking instructions? Terrible.

- The unit is on the fifth floor of a building with no elevator and a very narrow staircase, making luggage difficult to carry. After spending some time in the unit, we realized there were multiple deficiencies. First, the unit is very loud, right on a busy street. Second was the furnishings. Everything was very cheap and seemingly furnished on the assumption that when something breaks, it is just thrown out and replaced. The host did not provide enough supplies like toilet paper and soap for our stay. Third, there were numerous damages in the unit including dents and holes in the wall, a broken toaster and kettle, and poorly secured bathroom fixtures. Many of the remotes for the ceiling fans and air conditioning were missing batteries. When we raised some of these issues with the host they were responsive and fixed some of them promptly, but the overall impression was that they were trying to keep their costs as low as possible. Unfortunately I would not stay here again.

- Firstly this air bnb had breathtaking views. YES it is up a lot of stairs but it is a very old building and it is well worth climbing a few steps for the view of the river! The location is perfect for walking to restaurants, cafes etc but I don’t recommend this location if you are a light sleeper as it can be very noisy at night (didn’t bother me but my husband didn’t sleep well at all). The kitchen didn’t have any stock at all, there was a coffee machine but no coffee, a kettle but no tea bags or sugar. No oil, salt anything that you’d normally get in an air BnB. We also had to buy washing up liquid as they gave such a small sachet that it ran out after one day. They did give dishwasher tablets but there is no dishwasher? The beds are not comfortable at all. You get one pillow each. You can only close the blinds if the windows are shut which wasn’t fun. All in all, I probably wouldn’t come back here.
- Die Unterkunft hatte leider viel Schimmel an den Wänden und war dunkel. Anders als auf den Bildern. Die Lage ist jedoch unschlagbar.
- Great location. Apartment was good but the bathroom/shower had mildew. Bravissimo was very responsive to address this issue during our stay.
- It was a shame we had several problems with the AC and the hot water. Maintenance had to come several times. Bravissimo answered the enquiries very quickly.

- I love Girona as a place I’ve been to Girona multiple times.. great for cycling. I’ve had loads of apartments over the years.. fair few with Bravissimo.. Sadly this apartment didn’t match all the others we’ve had. Don’t get me wrong, location good, it was clean. Just ok. Apartment small, lift was a nightmare. Trying to get bikes in and out was ridiculous. I think they should advise cycling people in the apartment listing about this!! Bike boxes just went in.. being on the 6th floor no way you could go up and down with bikes very narrow stairwell. Also asked for early checkin but got told no… We wanted to ride first day hense early flights. Bravissimo office staff let us unpack out bikes in office get changed. So we ended up riding which was good. Thanks for that 👍 Honestly I wouldn’t recommend this apartment if you’re bringing bikes.. other than that it’s ok.

- Upon arrival, we found the fans covered in dust, and the sheets in the main bedroom had both blood stains and hair on them. As a result, we slept in the front bedroom on the first night. Unfortunately, that bed was extremely firm and uncomfortable. I messaged the host at 9:30 a.m., and while a very kind staff member came around 5:00 p.m. to clean and replace all of the bedding, the overall cleanliness of the apartment remained below expectations. The apartment felt quite dusty throughout our stay, and much of the furniture in the main living area was also uncomfortable. The apartment was stocked with basic dishes, cookware, and silverware, but otherwise provided only the bare minimum. There were no essentials such as salt, pepper, olive oil, or coffee. The balcony off the main bedroom is not private as shown and overlooks the below neighbors pool. Additionally, there are several flights of stairs to get in/out of the apt. I would not recommend for families with small children.

- Pros: The location is excellent, and it was spacious for a family of four. The TV gave us access to World Cup games. 2 of the 3 nights were quiet, although on the fourth there was street noise audible until late in the night. Cons: The apartment is rundown overall. I was quite surprised by the positive reviews, perhaps it has become run down over time. There was peeling paint and damaged moulding. There is mold in the shower and in the kitchen area closets—the smell is quite strong when you open those cabinets. The fridge was slightly open when we arrived and took hours to cool down again. The balconies are nice but the shutters don’t open all the way. We were given towels with stains on them, and the beds were uncomfortable. It took 24 hrs to get enough towels for all of us, although we had registered all of our guests. We have stayed in 50+ midrange airBnBs across multiple countries and this was honestly one of the worst stays. We would not stay here—or with Bravissimo—again.

- La mia impressione è che Bravissimo non sia in linea con lo spirito di Airbnb. Prima mi hanno chiesto una cauzione e, solo dopo mie richieste di chiarimento, si sono resi conto che i membri di Airbnb non la devono versare. Ti fanno registrare su una piattaforma parallela che serve anche per il check in, invece di usare quella di Airbnb. Non sanno dirti se puoi anticipare l'orario del checkin fino al giorno dell'arrivo perchè è una gestione di tipo alberghiero. Tuttavia, non ha i vantaggi di un hotel: in casa, c'è una vecchia macchinetta del caffè ma non ti lasciano la capsule, che difficilmente acquisti per pochi giorni di soggiorno; se hai un problema con la casa, chi ti scrive non la conosce e l'unica soluzione che riesce a proporti è far venire dei tecnici. In sintesi, lo sconsiglio.
- El apartamento es muy bonito y tranquilo pero necesita un poco de mantenimiento

- Die Unterkunft hat eine top Lage und entspricht den Bildern. Check In war super angemeh . Einziger Kritikpunkt: Die Sauberkeit in der Küche war nicht sehr gut: Wir fanden viel Geschirr & Besteck mit Rückständen drauf, welches wir zuerst abwaschen mussten. Und in den Zimmern ist die Klimatisierung sehr schwierig, was dazu führt, dass ständig eine leichte Feuchtigkeit im Zimmer herrscht. Daher hat es in den Zimmern an den Wänden und in den Ecken auch relativ viele kleine Schimmel Partien.

- The location is excellent, near to a supermarket and steps away from the old city. A truly magical location! The host, (different people communicated with us each time we reached out) was receptive, helpful, and timely. Visiting the first week in January, we were cold the first night, however, an extra heater was provided within 24 hours, which made a big difference. My only slight discomfort, was that the shower was very small and I was unable to bend easily. We had a wonderful time during our three nights day. Highly recommend.

- Its clean apartment in perfect location The parking garage is 5 min walk from front door. The only things is the stairs to the apartment inside the building is too much and very narrow to bring your luggage to your apartment. At all i like it and was good stay

- Schöne, grosse Wohnung, sehr ruhig. Mitten im Zentrum. Kommunikation perfekt. Kleiner Makel: keine Grundnahrungsmittel wie Zucker, Salz usw vorrätig: das Gebäude in dem sich die Wohnung befindet, ist nicht sehr einladend.
- Lovely apartment, great location and will definitely be coming back to stay!

- El departamento está muy bien , limpio e igual al de las fotos . El edificio es viejo , requiere mantenimiento y hay mucho ruido de la calle y los vecinos . La respuesta de Bravissimo es excelente ante nuestras dudas y solicitudes. Nos sentimos muy cómodos , la ubicación es ideal, las camas muy cómodas y está totalmente equipado . El equipamiento está en excelentes condiciones .
- Mooi appartement midden in de stad!
- Excelente lugar para hospedarse, céntrico y con varios restaurantes y servicios muy cerca, la atención de 10
- Todo correcto según las fotos ,la única pega que tuve que ir hasta a la oficina a por la llaves un vez aparcado el coche y queda un poco apartada del alojamiento lo demás todo genial .
- The apartment is large and well located in Girona. The team at Bravissimo was very responsive and communicated well. We really enjoyed our stay in Girona.

- The apartment was very well situation and nicely decorated, lots of storage space However it’s right above an Irish bar so if you’re into the bar scene then it’s perfect and convenient. But if you’re the opposite then be aware that the noise can last until 4amon the weekend or holiday

- On the positive side, it's a lovely, spacious apartment in the heart of the old town. Really nice. However, the hosts need to make things easier for the clients. Tedious check-in requires uploading data from the passports of all the guests and a high-tech locking mechanism. The manual key did not work. Once inside, there was no soap. No hand soap at either bathroom sink. No shower gel in the shower. When this was brought to the attention of the host, it was blamed on the cleaning staff. The host brought a refill for the shower gel and a small bar of hand soap. When I asked about the soap for the 2nd bathroom, I was told there was nothing else in their stock room. (hint: the proper reaction is to go to a mini-market around the corner and spend €1 to buy a small bar of soap.) Also, the host, despite running a hospitality company, cannot negotiate a good parking rate. You will save 30% booking the parking on your own. Nice apartment, but the hosts need to be more mindful.
- Assez bon séjour en sois mûr très isoler donc pas de réseau ou très peu de réseau sinon en général sa allait très bien regarder les photo ce sont deux petit lit coller donc ne pas se faire avoir
- X

- Small and cozy house in the centre of Girona. Perfect for a couple. Location is great the house was clean and with everything. Communication great and self check in very easy. If you have problems sleeping with light bring an eye mask!
- Bel appartement bien placé et propre .

- Logement vraiment bien situé pour accéder au centre ville et au parc. Bravissimo toujours aussi professionnel. Tout le nécessaire pour une semaine était présent. Bémol sur la proximité du bar pour une des 3 chambres. Parking possible dans la rue avec un peu de chance mais sinon le grand parking gratuit est très proche également.
- Fantàstica!

- El apartamento és precioso. Tiene todas las comodidades. No es ni muy frío ni muy caluroso. Todo estaba limpio y bien cuidado. Destacaría que el televisor no és Smart TV. El apartamento és muy oscuro. Está bien iluminado con bombillas pero solo tiene la ventana de la habitación que entra algo de luz. Está ventana dá al patio de un vecino y al no tener cortinas hay que dejarla cerrada. En cuanto a la ubicación es perfecta, cerca de la catedral pero hay que subir muchas escaleras o rampas para llegar. No recomendado para personas con movilidad reducida. Me puse en contacto con el anfitrión por un problema con las almohadas y no me lo pudieron resolver, aunque contestaron rápido. Cama cómoda pero las almohadas,no. Al entrar se nota olor a humedad por las paredes de piedra pero luego te acostumbras. La ducha es una maravilla.

- The apartment is clean and conveniently located. Overall, the stay was fine, but there were significant issues with the shower. It was leaking and water was flowing out onto the bathroom floor. Unfortunately, this was not resolved during my stay. Also, please note that there are no basic household items (such as oil, salt, tea), so even for a short stay you’ll need to purchase everything yourself.

- This unit was exactly as described. The check in and out instructions were clear and easy. The area is great with good restaurants and shopping. Our host was responsive and helpful. I would recommend.

- The apartment was very lovely and in a great location. Staff was also super responsive with any questions. The one thing that bothered me, is that a lot of practical stuff was missing from the apartment. For example, there was a washing machine and dishwasher but no soap to use for either of them. The kitchen was spacious, but there were no basics (olive oil, salt + pepper) like you find in most apartments, and no dish soap to clean your dishes with if you did cook. There was also nowhere to hang your towel in the bathroom. None of those things are major, but definitely impacted the usefulness of the amenities.
- m
- Gran apartament amb 4 habitacions per allotjar a professionals que no volen compartir, tot exterior, molt ben situat
- Great location - close to everything. If someone is cycling - definetelly challenging to get bikes up and down.

- Mooi appartement met zuivere keuken en badkamer. Een vaatwasser en enkele extra keukenhanddoeken zou een bonus zijn... Onze bovenbuur was wel heel rumoerig. Leek soms dat hij turnlessen aan het geven was. Of was het extra hard stampen op de vloek. Maakte er ook een gewoonte van om 2 uur snachts wasmachiene te laten zwieren. Toch leuke tijd gehad. Was ongeveer wat we verwacht/gehoopt hadden. Zou zeker terug komen.
- Very responsive to an issue we had with the shower, any problems they’re quick to respond and help

- Schönes, sauberes und modernes Apartment. Sehr zentrale Lage. Recht kleines Badezimmer ohne Ablagefläche. Das Treppenhaus ist sehr eng und hat eine Wendeltreppe - das Mitnehmen von Rädern in die Wohnung ist somit quasi nicht möglich.

- Great location, between Barri Vell and downtown, for walking to the bus stop, the market, shopping, restaurants, bars, and historic points of interest. The church bells weren't bothersome, as described in another review, but rather quaint. We enjoyed our stay.
- Lage war perfekt, alles sauber... Als einziges Manko : keine Geschirrtücher und Duschkopf defekt
- Genial estancia, buena localización.

- Charming apartment. We went to wrong building but they came right away to help let us in since the our code wasn’t working. Wish these apartments had some cooking essentials like oil or salt but understand why they don’t.

- Great apartment in an excellent location… right next to the shops and restaurants in Girona. Despite being so central it was surprisingly quiet when the windows were closed. Beautiful decor, spacious living area, comfortable beds, and a great shower. Only one bathroom for five people but it was manageable. Worth noting one bedroom doesn’t have an external window. If you’re travelling with mtb bikes, getting them up and down the stairs and carrying bike boxes from the nearest free parking can be a bit tricky. For the price and location though it was worth it. A couple of small tips: bring extra dishwasher/washing tablets and watch for a few cracked tiles in bare feet. Overall a lovely place, good value, responsive host and we had a great stay. Would definitely recommend and hope to return soon. Thanks 😊
- Great spot, responsive host

- Lovely little apartment in attractive part of Girona. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend. Particularly grateful for the speedy and effective response to queries about the heating and taxis.
- This is a great place, very peaceful and quiet with a short walk down the hill into the city. Great for cycling.

- Excellent apartment, beautifully designed, clean, and tidy. The check-in process was easy, and they made sure to leave two keys available on the table. The location is superb! ​Areas for improvement: The building key seemed to be a poor duplicate, so it took a few tries to get the door open. Also, they weren't flexible at all regarding the check-in time, which is relatively late (4:00 PM). ​Overall, though, it’s a truly great apartment in an amazing location

- This apartment has both strong positives and some notable drawbacks. On the plus side, the location is excellent—very close to the walled city and main tourist attractions. The outdoor patio is a real highlight, especially with the fragrant tangerine trees. The apartment also offers a washer and dryer and spacious rooms and bathroom, and plenty of natural light throughout. However, there are a few issues to be aware of. The biggest concern is that the bathroom can flood when using the shower. Additionally, the kitchen is under-equipped, lacking basic essentials like salt, sugar, oil, and tea towels. The sink is also awkwardly positioned, which makes it difficult to use comfortably.
- Great location, beautiful apartment. Check in was smooth and the team were very helpful. the stairs with luggage were alot, but we forgave this for the views and location.

- Sehr schöne Wohnung, tolle Lage schnell im Zentrum der Altstadt. Wohnung ist gross und hat gut Platzt für 4-6 Personen. Gute Küchenausstattung um selbst zu Kochen. Kommunikation war immer sehr schnell und freundlich, wir konnten auch unkompliziert 1 Nacht verlängern. Leider war der angebotene Fahrradkeller nicht vorhanden und es war umständlich die Fahrräder in die Wohnung zu nehmen. Mit einem Ebike wäre es unmöglich gewesen. Die Wohnung hat uns sehr gefallen und wir haben uns wohlgefühlt.

- This accommodation is beautiful and comfortable. Plenty of space and lovely bathroom. Decor is lovely. The only issue we had was two sets of church bells that rang on the hour and also each quarter hour even through the nights. Maybe if you are a very deep sleeper it wouldn’t be an issue. Our child slept through but it was a problem for both of us. Ear plugs helped a bit but did not block out. Friends who stayed a little further out of the old town could not hear them as much.

- The apartment itself is charming although very dark with not much natural light coming in. Bed was comfy and the bathroom was lovely. The apartment is tucked away near the cathedral but is up several flights of stairs. If you have any mobility issues this apartment might not be for you. We, as a couple of retired (late 60/70’s) found the location difficult- our fault as should have read previous reviews. We had instructions also to go to the office first to pick up the keys which added to the journey. However if you are after an authentic charming apartment then this is the place for you.
- Appartement très bien placé, fonctionnel et bien décoré pour un week-end à Gerone. Tout est accessible à pied. Un bémol, le canapé-lit est très mou.

- It‘s right in the center. So location is perfect. You have no view in this place. The living room window goes onto one of the nice old streets. So you see the house across. It‘s the ground level floor so you can bring in bikes easily and they can be in the courtyard. The courtyard is not a place to be in the Spring. There is no sun in there. It might be helpful in the hot season. It is convenient for keeping your doors open at night . Unfortunately at times it has a sulfur smell that is not pleasant. The apartment has all you need. The kitchen is basic. The bathroom is small. It’s an apartment on the smaller side for 4 people.
- Nice accomodation in the center of Girona!
- Très bonne expérience dans ce logement

- Super emplacement, Meuble de salon très ordinaire, le carrelage de la douche plusieurs endroits avec de la moisissures, aucun linge à vaisselle , aucun savon vaisselle aucun pods de lave vaisselle très peu de Scott towel ,aucune attention d’arrivée,, avec un Check in à 16hrs un samedi et tout les commerces fermés le dimanche ,, disons que sé pas très agréable comme début de vacances ,,,J’ai déjà vécu beaucoup mieux en termes de fournitures par le passé à ce prix.
- Great location. Walkable to Old Town Girona.

- We had a lovely time here. Travelling with a full family the apartment was very suitable for our trip to Girona. 2 min walk from the heart of Girona. The management team was very responsive to questions or requests and were able to accommodate an early check in. The host was responsive and attempted to resolve a plumbing odor in the bathroom during our stay, though the issue persisted. While the main surfaces were tidy, we found several overlooked items from previous guests (including old food and clothing) under the furniture while retrieving a child's toy. With a more deep-clean approach and a permanent fix for the bathroom drainage, this would be a great stay.

- We had a really lovely stay at this apartment and would definitely recommend it. The location is perfect; everything is within walking distance, and you are right in the middle of the old town. The highlight for us was the balcony with a direct view of the cathedral. It was such a nice spot to sit, relax, and watch the activity around the cathedral, a really special atmosphere. The apartment itself is well equipped and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Communication and check-in were also smooth and easy. Another big plus is the surroundings: there is a bar right downstairs, which makes it perfect to end the evening with a relaxed beer. Overall, a great stay with lots of charm and a unique view. We would happily come back!

- The apartment is located in the heart of old Girona. It has all the amenities except there is no elevator and the steps are very narrow which makes getting luggage and especially bikes into the apartment a challenge. Other than that it was a great place to stay.
- Great stay thank you

- A nice little flat in a nice location but the only issue was the square outside was hosting a conserts on two of the nights we were staying with the stage 10m from the balcony and these went on until midnight so no chance to sleep before then.
- We had some issues with getting into apartment due to lack of connection or broken system. Also apartment is not well marked. Rest was really good we loved the apartment, perfect location !
- Close to Girona Old town. Clean. Quiet.

- Nice apartment in the center of the old quarter. Well situated near lots of cafes, bars and restaurants. Everything is in walking distance. So if you want to be in the middle of the action, this is the place for you. The downside is you will be dealing with a lot of noise from the surrounding restaurants until midnight or 1 in the morning. In addition, they have a late night time garbage collection schedule in the city that can also be very disruptive on certain days of the week.

- The apartment is lovely. Really beautiful inside. It was on the edge of the old town, so everything was easily walkable. Restaurants, bakeries, shops on the doorstep. The suggestions I’d have is to have some basic staples like tea / coffee/ salt / pepper. And some hooks to put your towels on so they can dry easily.

- Middenin oude centrum, appartement is ook brand schoon. Goed bed en bedbank, douche, keuken met allerlei voorzieningen. Aardige snel reagerend bureau. Mochten daar onze koffers parkeren en kregen vroegere inchecktijd dan 16:00 omdat het appartement eerder schoon was. Reden dat we geen 5 sterren geven is dat de ziel een beetje ontbreekt als je het vergelijkt met een particuliere host; ligt bijv geen informatieboek (gaat via een app) of dat er nog wat zout of peper is achtergelaten. Dus doet wat clean aan. Maar al met al toch zeer tevreden.
- Lovely central spot, in the heart of the city. Super clean and very responsive host.

- We had a very good stay overall and felt that the apartment offered great value for money. The location in the center of Girona was excellent, and access through the digital app was very convenient. Communication with the host was also very good, with fast response times throughout our stay. We had a small issue with an electric switch and the couch, but the host reacted quickly and sent mechanics the next day to fix everything, which we really appreciated. The living room and dining area were spacious and comfortable, and the bedrooms were perfectly fine as well. The only downside was the kitchen setup. Basic essentials such as salt, pepper, oil, and vinegar were missing. For cleaning, there was no kitchen towel or proper cleaning supplies, so we had to use bathroom towels to dry things in the kitchen and even buy soap ourselves. Apart from that, we would definitely recommend this place.

- Stayed a week for a cycling trip and the location is hard to beat. Northern edge of Barri Vell, 30 seconds to a grocery store, cafés, and restaurants. A bit of city traffic on the way out before reaching quieter cycling roads. We parked in the free lot next to La Copa, which filled up during the Flower Festival and market days but worked overall. Clean, well laid out, with proper wall mounts for road bikes. Wifi was fast and reliable for remote work and video calls. Host was very responsive and accommodated an early check-in.A few honest notes. Street noise at night is noticeable, a bit disruptive but not unbearable, possibly worse during the Flower Festival. With no AC it's a tradeoff: open the window for air and accept the noise, or keep it shut. Manageable in early May, harder in peak summer. Kitchen is fully equipped but has zero pantry basics, plan a grocery run on arrival. Check-in app works but isn't polished. Solid base for a Girona cycling trip and we'd consider staying again!

- Spacious apartment which felt light, airy and well presented. It was centrally placed very close to the old town, restaurants and shops. Would highly recommend staying! Girona is such a great historical city with easy access to Barcelona and the cycling is fantastic!
- Logement très bien situé pour visiter Gérone à pied. Conforme à l'annonce et propre, il était cependant un peu bruyant à cause de l'isolation moyenne de l'immeuble.

- The location was perfect, very close to the old town and to the new modern part of town with all the shops. The hosts were very responsive, very communicative about anything that we needed from them or to ask about the city. We spent a few nights there and we were planning to cook breakfasts there, but there wasn't any oil, salt, or pepper, so we had to buy those. Be mindful if you're planning to cook. We also were short on kitchen paper. There was only one roll, and there were no napkins or anything, so we're short on that. Also, I believe there was only one bathroom with extra toilet paper, so we were also struggling a little bit with that. Other than that, the place was perfect.

- We had a very enjoyable week-long stay and would happily recommend this apartment, particularly for cyclists. The location is excellent, within easy walking distance of the old town while also being well positioned for getting in and out of town on rides. The ground-floor access was especially convenient for bikes, and there was plenty of space to store them. The apartment was quiet at night and we slept brilliantly throughout our stay. The kitchen was well equipped with everything we needed, including a Nespresso coffee machine. Communication from Bravissimo was excellent from start to finish, with quick and helpful responses whenever needed. A few minor issues prevented a five-star stay: some areas could do with more thorough dusting, the sofa is showing signs of wear and staining, and there was an occasional drain smell in the courtyard. Overall, though, this is a comfortable, well-located apartment with great amenities and excellent host communication.
- סטודיו קטן ונוח במרכז העיר. תקשורת טובה עם המארחים (העסקיים). הייתה תקלה בזרימת המים שתוקנה ביום המחרת.

- super spot in the very middle of the historic town, clean and spacious and lots to do the second you leave the apartment. we were here for a cycling holiday, so we were grateful there was an elevator to transport our bikes (small but fits 1 perfectly).

- As a family of 4 ( daughters 16 and 20) from the US, we loved the apartment 2B. Pros: Excellent location Excellent air conditioning Two full length windows that open like doors for people watching Excellent hair dryer Lots of counter space in the bathrooms and entryway 1.5 bathrooms Excellent coffee shop next door and empanadas across the street Cons Key system was difficult. Another Bravissimo guest let us into the building and showed us how to use the code to get into the apartment. We never got the fob to work. Mold in shower Ventilation fan in main bathroom needs replacing- loud and ineffective From the listing, I thought it was 2 full bathrooms Would recommend it to anyone.
- Vše ok.

- Gorgeous location, clean and tidy. Ideally next to church, nice cafes and the water. Although as one perk of the stay was that the apartment had a washing machine, we would've appreciated if some more basic necessities had been left such as washing powder.

- Superb location in girona old town. Walking distance to everything you would need on a holiday in this place. The place was spacious and comfortable and the pull up bed was a handy addition. Only downside was the lack of amenities. We had a 10 day stay and only received 2 dishwashing tablets, no clothes washing product, no oil or salt or basics in the kitchen. For the price paid we would have expected better in this area.
- Excellent place to stay, particularly for a cycling holiday. Very spacious and beautiful area
- Great customer service. AC didn’t work for two nights and they went above and beyond to rectify this for us. Will stay with them next time we’re in Girona!

- We enjoyed our stay in Girona and found the apartment to be a great base for exploring the city— don’t miss the free walking tour everyday at 11am :) The layout worked especially well for our family. The bedroom can be separated from the living area with doors, which was great with a baby who still naps during the day. The apartment was quiet, the air conditioning worked well, and the beds and pillows were very comfortable. Even my 65-year-old mother, who usually struggles sleeping away from home, slept very well. A few things could be improved. The apartment could use a deeper clean, and the washing machine had some mildew buildup. It was also not as well stocked as most Airbnbs we've stayed in, so we had to purchase some basic kitchen and bathroom supplies during our stay. If you're arriving by car, I would avoid driving into the old city. The streets are extremely narrow and can be stressful to navigate. We used the free parking near the university.
- Great little flat! Really appreciated the location and bike friendly storage. Thanks so much Bravissimo!
- Apartamento muy agradable, comodo y tranquilo, estupendo para pasar un par de días. Lo recomiendo sin duda.
- Todo correcto

- Leuk appartement in het centrum van Girona. Alles op loopafstand, restaurantjes en winkels. Op de 2e verdieping, niet helemaal ideaal voor fietsers omdat alles via de lift moet maar op zich nog wel te doen.

- Great place to stay in Girona. Responsive and helpful hosts. Apartment was decent – a little bit bare and a few bits that’s benefit from some tlc but otherwise a good base for exploring the city. Would recommend.

- Beautiful neighborhood, right in the center of old town. Great coffee shop next door (Espresso Mafia) and tons of restaurants and shops all walkable. Also nice to have a lift. Nice to be on 4th floor because it was more quiet. Aircon worked great. Downside was shower head was broken and they said someone would fix but they never came. Also walls are dirty and bathroom fans quite dusty.
- Very local and accessible to great restaurants! Taking out the garbage is tricky, but got it figured out.

- Great apartment and location - very central in the Barri Vell and walking distance to plenty of restaurants and sites (Cathedral, river bridges, medieval walls, Cinema Museum, etc). It's a top-floor walkup but not uncommon in Europe and pretty easy even with suitcases. The flat itself was immaculate and very charming, with lovely windows overlooking the Placa del Vi, and a spacious, well-equipped kitchen and living area. The bedrooms are great with plenty of closet space, though worth noting that this is really a large studio with dividers, so there's no real privacy between bedrooms (perfect for me, as I was with my two young kids anyway, but not for everyone). Only minor inconvenience was that little effort made to accommodate a slightly earlier check-in despite repeated inquiries (normal check-in at 4pm) - the door code automatically appears at that time.

- This is a great apartment, very centrally located. Very close to the old town. It is on the 4th floor, so quite a hike and lacks AC in the bedrooms. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend the apartment if a lack of AC and enforced exercise are not deal breakers.

- We had a wonderful stay. The apartment is in a great location, is wonderfully generous and airy, and is well equipped. The only issue we had was that the fridge was making a slightly irritating (and quite loud!) noise but we reported this and we were assured that this would be looked at and resolved by the maintenance team. This issue did not spoil our stay. We would definitely stay again and would recommend this apartment.

- Great location in the middle of old town. Lively area, with the bedroom windows facing the street so you can hear cars and people walking by if they’re talking. Aircon worked great with the summer heat. Very clean. I would stay here again, as long as I wasn’t planning to bike. The stairs, as mentioned in the description, are very steep and narrow.
- The apartment has everything you need. Very close to the city center. Staff is very helpfull and the phisical office is a plus for immediately support. I recommend it!

No volvería - El apartamento está bien, es amplio y cómodo El apartamento tiene mucho ruido de la calle, las paredes son de papel de escucha todo lo del apartamento de arriba y de al lado El personal que gestiona la reserva, facilidades cero, este apartamento es el claro ejemplo de que en el turismo todo vale Todo automátizado no se si con la persona que hable por WhatsApp era una persona o una IA
No vuelvo - La ubicación Las escaleras para acceder al apartamento. Es un tema que lo han de poner con más claridad

Tres días complicados al no poder dormir - El alojamiento está muy bien ubicado y es cómodo No se puede dormir, descansar. Las campanas de la Iglesia suenan durante las 24 horas sin parar, dando varios toques a todas horas por lo que es muy complicado descansar y conciliar el sueño. La respuesta del alojamiento es que es una tradición de hace siglos y es lo que hay
- L'emplacement Il y'a une oder horrible dans la salle de bain et les escaliers sont trop fatiguant

Girona merece la pena ser visitada - La ubicación La casa estaba sucia. La sábana que protege el colchón estaba llena de pelos en todas las camas. Los cristales del salón sucios. El frigorífico es muy ruidoso y molestaba para dormir. Hay un problema de tuberías de forma que de repente empezaba a subir agua por el desagüe del fregadero y el lavabo del baño de la suite no tragaba el agua con normalidad. En resumen, a pesar de que estéticamente está bien y la ubicación es muy buena, necesita atención en cuanto a limpieza y reparación de tuberías.

Enttäuschender Aufenhalt wegen schlafloser Nächte - An Schlaf war nicht zu denken: das Rollo im Hauptschlafzimmer war abgebaut, die Gardinen lichtdurchlässig (s. Fotos), die Straße hell beleuchtet. Sehr ärgerlich und enttäuschend, was haben sich die Vermieter dabei gedacht? Bisher hatten wir mit unseren Aufenthalten bei den Bravissimo Appartements in Girona gute Erfahrungen - schade.

OK, but won't repeat. - Despite the sound of the train being loud, the location is pretty good. There were places where I bet it's never been cleaned. Spiderwebs made it look like a Halloween theme :( Additionally, the fan of the air conditioning equipment looks like a nest of diseases.

- Locatie + communicatie met dehost Er liepen veel mieren door het huis en in de keuken, rioollucht bij gebruik wasbak in doucheruimte en vensterbank in woonkamer was vorig jaar al kapot en nu nog steeds.

Billige Wohnung, den Preis dennoch nicht wert. - Wohnzimmer und Küche wie beschrieben Die Lage im ersten Stock ist schlecht: laut und auf gleicher Höhe wie die meist begangene Brücke Gironas. Das zweite Zimmer ist ein Witz: ein Holzverschlag, nicht wirklich heizbar. Im Bad hat es sehr stark nach Fäkalien gerochen und die Möblierung ist generell äusserst billig.

Lugar céntrico pero ruidoso, no muy limpio y el proceso de registro complicado. - La ubicación es estupenda, muy céntrica con respecto al casco antiguo. La cama es muy cómoda. La calle siempre es ruidosa y también se oye el ruido de los ocupantes del edificio todo el tiempo. El proceso del chek-in es un dolor de cabeza. Hay que rellenar previamente los datos y luego firmar el contrato antes de la fecha de llegada, excepto que no se puede firmar hasta que hayas pagado el impuesto municipal. Ese se puede pagar solo 2 días antes de la llegada y solo entonces puedes firmar el contrato y recibir el PIN para entrar por la puerta principal del edificio. Una vez dentro, tienes que haberte bajado la aplicación en tu celular para desbloquear la puerta del apartamento y solo después puedes acceder y recuperar la llave, que en realidad es una etiqueta electrónica. El alojamiento era para mis suegros y todo el proceso parecía un juego de búsqueda del tesoro y era muy molesto que requiriera tantos pasos diferentes que no se pueden hacer todos al mismo tiempo. Además, el suelo del apartamento estaba sucio y hacía un frío helador. Habría sido amable que hubieran encendido la calefacción al menos un par de horas antes de nuestra llegada. Solo hay un pequeño armario; no hay espacio para guardar la ropa. Se entiende que los propietarios tienen la intención de automatizar todo el proceso de reserva, pero habría sido agradable mostrar al menos un mínimo de interacción humana o gestos de bienvenida para los huéspedes.

Good location but poor instructions and guidance on how to enter the property or where to leave bags - Good location The pictures sent to get into the property didn’t match the actual door so it was hard to get in, resulting in delays. And then we were given the wrong address to leave our bags after we checked out, resulting in a long wasted walk.
Buena ubicación, pero muy fría - La ubicación Hacía frío a la llegada y la calefacción es muy lenta, tardó más de 24 horas en estar confortable. La calle de salida es muy estrecha, se debería avisar.

Sitio muy agradable para ir fuera de la temporada de invierno. Localización perfecta. - Ubicación inmejorable. El apartamento es muy bonito y la distribución muy acogedora, agradable y original. Exorbitant cleaning fee and you are required to do a lot of it like strip beds and take out garbage (which is a complicated time sensitive undertaking). You are required to pick up keys from the property manager’s office then walk 10 minutes with your bags to the unit - there is no self check in process. These things would be less annoying for a long stay where you are “living” in the unit and only need to park once, buy groceries and the cleaning cost is amortized over a longer stay, but for a day or two these things can be a hassle. Una pena que con pequeños detalles, la estancia hubiera sido perfecta - Ubicación y reforma con gusto La ubicación es excelente, en pleno centro de Girona, con todo a mano y en una zona muy agradable un para recorrer la ciudad. Al estar en una calle muy transitada, hay algo de ruido por las noches, pero es algo esperable dada la localización. La reforma del apartamento está hecha con mucho gusto y el resultado es muy bonito, tanto en las habitaciones como en los baños. Sin embargo, la limpieza ha sido el gran punto negativo de nuestra estancia. En nuestra opinión, está muy por debajo de lo que se espera en un alojamiento de estas características. Encontramos telarañas en las barandillas del balcón, especialmente en las que dan a la calle principal, que claramente no se limpian desde hace mucho tiempo, así como suciedad en las ventanas exteriores. También había polvo acumulado encima de los cuadros de una de las habitaciones, un ticket de restaurante encima del armario de la segunda habitación, suciedad en rincones, cristales bastante opacos y una papelera con restos de una caja de bombilla. La sensación general era de falta de limpieza profunda y de mantenimiento. Todas estas observaciones fueron documentadas con fotografías tomadas durante nuestra estancia. Además, nos sorprendió comprobar que la cama del dormitorio principal no tenía funda de colchón. En la segunda habitación, formada por dos camas individuales unidas, una de ellas tenía funda y la otra no. Consideramos que se trata de un aspecto básico de higiene que debería estar garantizado en cualquier alojamiento. Los productos de limpieza disponibles eran correctos, pero claramente insuficientes para varios días. Se indica que se proporcionan para dos días y que, si se necesita más, hay que comprarlos. Lo entendemos, pero en una estancia de cuatro días resultaría lógico disponer, por ejemplo, de cuatro cápsulas para el lavavajillas en lugar de dos. La fregona estaba en muy mal estado y la mopa no tenía recambios, lo que dificulta mantener el apartamento en condiciones adecuadas durante la estancia.

Centrally located apartment but disappointed with a lot of its features. - They had a great check in system via the Bravissimo App which made it very convenient for us. Location was good and central. Lots of shops and restaurants nearby There are a few things we did'nt like: 1. First was although the description indicates there is AIRCONDITIONING, there was only one AC and it was located in the family hall entrance. The rooms only had CEILING FANS. We visited during the summer and so the Rooms got pretty unpleasant during the day, even at night time. We had to keep our bedroom doors open so that the cold from the AC would filter to our rooms. I pity our companion whose room was at the very end of the hallway because his room was always hot. 2. There was no Elevator and the unit is located on the 3rd Floor. Although there was no mention of this in the property description, I think it should be indicated as the unit is on the top most floor. Let the potential clients decide if its worth it or not, especially if somebody in the group has some type of disability. We had a challenging time bringing our luggages up when we checked in and also bringing them down when we checked out. We visited Girona to cycle and we had to carry our bikes up 3 flights of stairs everytime we finished our ride. What made it worst was the stairs were very narrow and it can be quite dangerous to traverse up and down when bringing down your bike. 3. I informed the person handling the unit via the app that there was a light in one of the rooms that was not working. In fact, there were several also in the hallway that were inop. They said they will send someone to replace it but no one ever came. Also, the property details indicated there was a blow dryer, but non was to be found.

Fabulous Location - perfect for a short stay. - We had a wonderful stay at Bravissimo Place Catalunya. While the apartment was a bit smaller than we had expected, the location could not be beat. Very nice to have. The shower head is very tall. My tall husband appreciated this very much. The photos are exactly as described. Try the chocolate shop downstairs. It’s delicious. Oh and did I mention the location. A++++ We did not find many cons other than the bathroom is small and there is no counter in there, but they did install a small shelf which was helpful to place supplies on. A few things I would note though that could be a concern for some people are that the apartment is up one level (US-2nd floor, EU-first floor) and there is no elevator. If you have mobility issues this could be a concern. We do not, so it was fine for us. And there is no dresser (chest of drawers) so if you’re staying for an extended stay there isn’t really anywhere to put your clothing. There is a large closet though that has a few shelves. I don’t want to focus on the negative though because these were minor things. The apartment was perfect for our stay.

Mooie tijd gehad met spannende momenten met auto rijden door erg smalle straatjes - De ligging. Centraal gelegen. Perfect. Wel van belang dat de gasten weten dat er veel klimwerk aan te pas komt.
